complaints.title: Enterprise API gateway timed out during evening peak and 500+ tracking requests failed
complaints.description: At 7:00 PM yesterday during our highest e-commerce traffic window, RaftarXpress Enterprise API gateway (`api.raftarxpress.com/v2/shipment`) completely crashed with continuous 504 Gateway Timeout errors. Over 500 customers tracking their consignments received broken error pages on our storefront, and our warehouse dispatch robots were locked out from generating shipping labels for 2 hours.
complaints.requested_resolution: Provision of root-cause analysis (RCA) report and credit note for technical SLA downtime breach

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Enterprise corporate client API gateway completely down or returning 5xx errors
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Warehouse automated shipping label generation halted during peak operational window
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Critical enterprise infrastructure outage halting client e-commerce operations and barcode fulfillment.

complaints.title: Late delivery refund requested on 8th day after delivery and parcel delivered with crushed packaging
complaints.description: My parcel CN-771029384 arrived 8 days ago in Lahore after suffering a 5-day delay past the promised express deadline. The carton was badly dented and the inner ceramic vase cracked. I was traveling for work so I could only submit my refund request today on day 8. Your portal says refunds must be requested within 7 days, but this delay was your fault and the package arrived crushed!
complaints.requested_resolution: Policy exception to process late refund request and compensate PKR 6,500 damaged vase

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Refund request submitted on day 8 (past 7-day window) with extenuating delivery delay
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Parcel delivered with crushed outer packaging and damaged internal ceramic merchandise
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Customer requesting policy exception for day-8 refund submission due to transit delay and carton damage.

complaints.title: Parcel dumped in communal apartment hallway without consent and subsequently stolen
complaints.description: Your delivery courier left my prepaid parcel CN-2291029384 containing PKR 35,000 worth of designer clothes on the shared 3rd-floor hallway floor of our apartment complex in Karachi while I was at my office. He did not ring my bell, did not contact building reception, and had no permission to drop it unattended. When I returned home at 6 PM, the parcel was stolen! Building CCTV shows a stranger walking off with it.
complaints.requested_resolution: Full reimbursement of PKR 35,000 stolen parcel value and disciplinary action against courier

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Package left unattended without consent and subsequently lost/stolen
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Courier failed to deliver to authorized recipient or building security reception
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Negligent drop-off in public apartment hallway leading directly to theft of high-value goods.

complaints.title: Bulk refund delayed across 60 merchant accounts and portal falsely reports payments completed
complaints.description: Our merchant consortium of 60 apparel sellers has not received approved return refunds totaling PKR 920,000 that were authorized two weeks ago. When our merchants login to the RaftarXpress partner portal, every return transaction is marked 'Refund Processed via IBFT', yet our corporate banking statements across HBL, Meezan, and Bank Alfalah confirm that zero funds have cleared. Where is our money?
complaints.requested_resolution: Immediate manual disbursement of PKR 920,000 and reconciliation of false portal transaction receipts

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Bulk merchant refund batch delayed across 50+ accounts totaling > PKR 500,000
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Contradictory portal system status claiming payment completed while bank accounts remain uncredited
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Large-scale merchant refund batch failure with misleading portal status requires finance investigation.

complaints.title: Original legal property deed routed in endless loop between Lahore and Islamabad for 14 days
complaints.description: We booked original stamped property registry deeds (CN-6610293847, VIP Urgent Courier) from Lahore to the High Court registry in Islamabad on Sept 10th. The tracking history shows the parcel was sent to Islamabad, then mistakenly returned to Lahore Hub, then sent to Rawalpindi, and now returned to Lahore again! The court filing deadline has lapsed and our legal case has been dismissed due to your incompetence!
complaints.requested_resolution: Emergency physical interception of consignment and executive settlement for legal damages

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Repeated routing error on same consignment note (>2 times loop)
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Severe downstream legal consequence with court filing deadline forfeiture
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: P0 severe multi-loop routing failure causing irreversible legal case forfeiture for VIP client.

complaints.title: Rider repeatedly abuses elderly residents and refuses doorstep delivery in DHA Lahore
complaints.description: This is our 4th formal complaint regarding your delivery rider assigned to Sector Y, DHA Lahore. Yesterday, he refused to walk to the doorstep of my 78-year-old mother, demanding she walk down a 50-meter driveway in 40-degree heat to fetch parcel CN-3391028371. When our security guard intervened, the rider used abusive foul language, spat at the gate, and threatened to blacklist our home address.
complaints.requested_resolution: Permanent removal of this rider from our sector route and written assurance of doorstep delivery

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Repeated behavioral complaints (>3) against same delivery rider / staff member
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Refusal to provide doorstep delivery service to elderly consignee with verbal harassment
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Chronic rider behavioral misconduct and service refusal requiring immediate HR reassignment.

complaints.title: Sukkur highway floods block 30 refrigerated freight containers with diesel gensets failing
complaints.description: Due to Indus highway flooding near Sukkur, 30 of our corporate refrigerated containers carrying export-grade mangoes and dairy products are stranded on the national linehaul artery. Even worse, your fleet drivers report that their refrigeration auxiliary generators are running out of diesel and your roadside maintenance support has failed to deliver fuel refills, placing PKR 45M worth of cargo at imminent spoilage risk.
complaints.requested_resolution: Emergency fuel supply mobilization to stranded fleet and activation of force majeure insurance

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Nationwide highway flooding closes national transit artery with stranded commercial fleet
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Imminent spoilage of temperature-controlled agricultural cargo due to generator fuel depletion
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: P0 natural disaster contingency combining national highway paralysis with cold-chain fuel failure.

complaints.title: Mobile phone box sliced open and replaced with tile plus rider demanded COD before opening
complaints.description: I ordered an iPhone 15 Pro (CN-5591028374) via Cash on Delivery for PKR 310,000. When the courier arrived, he refused to let me inspect the outer box until I handed over the cash. After handing over the cash, I opened the box in front of him: the factory seal was carefully sliced with a blade, the phone was stolen, and a ceramic floor tile was taped inside. The rider immediately mounted his bike and fled with my money!
complaints.requested_resolution: Immediate return of cash PKR 310,000 and arrest of rider for organized package tampering

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Parcel cut open and high-value item replaced with counterfeit / filler material
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Rider coercively collected COD cash and absconded upon discovery of internal theft
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Severe P0 organized criminal tampering and theft incident involving rider complicity during COD exchange.

complaints.title: Merchant shipping manifest with 600+ customer records leaked online and phishing calls reported
complaints.description: We have discovered that a RaftarXpress shipping manifest containing over 600 customer names, personal phone numbers, CNIC copies, and residential delivery addresses was posted publicly on a Telegram channel. Within the last 24 hours, dozens of our female customers have received fraudulent calls from scammers claiming to be RaftarXpress riders demanding online card verification. This is a catastrophic breach of privacy!
complaints.requested_resolution: Emergency containment of leaked manifest, takedown notice, and formal notification to regulatory authorities

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Merchant manifests containing 500+ customer names and contact details leaked publicly
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Downstream social engineering and fraudulent phishing attacks targeting affected customers
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Critical P0 data breach involving massive PII exposure leading to active impersonation and scamming.

complaints.title: Undeclared lithium battery cargo ignited in linehaul van destroying 40 adjacent consignments
complaints.description: During midnight linehaul transit on the Karachi-Hyderabad Motorway, a consignment containing unmanifested industrial lithium battery packs caught fire inside van LH-3312. While the driver managed to pull over safely, the fire ignited neighboring cargo compartments, completely incinerating 40 commercial consignments belonging to our pharmaceutical laboratory. Why was hazardous cargo allowed without declaration?
complaints.requested_resolution: Incident investigation report, total loss compensation for 40 burned parcels, and legal action

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Consignment of undeclared lithium batteries catches fire causing vehicle cargo damage
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Collateral destruction of adjacent pharmaceutical shipments due to lack of Hazmat screening
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: P0 severe safety hazard involving undeclared hazardous goods combustion and widespread collateral cargo destruction.

complaints.title: Customs seized linehaul container at dry port and 150 client parcels impounded indefinitely
complaints.description: Pakistan Customs authorities at Lahore Dry Port have formally seized your linehaul container LH-9921 carrying 150 commercial client consignments due to lack of import clearance documents and suspected smuggling of electronic components. Our company's consignment CN-8819203948 is trapped inside, halting our assembly plant and threatening complete breach of our automotive supply agreements.
complaints.requested_resolution: Emergency legal intervention by corporate counsel to secure release of legitimate bonded freight

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Mass regulatory seizure of entire linehaul container / multiple client consignments
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Immobilization of corporate manufacturing assembly lines due to impounded components
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: P0 mass regulatory seizure impacting 150+ consignments and requiring immediate executive legal response.

complaints.title: Expired fuel surcharge of 19% billed across 250 invoices and support refused credit note
complaints.description: In our August consolidated billing statement, RaftarXpress applied a 19% fuel surcharge across 250 corporate invoices totaling an excess charge of PKR 240,000. Under our contractual amendment dated July 1st, the fuel surcharge was pegged to the official OGRA diesel price index, which caps the surcharge at 12%. When we called corporate accounts, the billing rep flatly refused to issue a credit note.
complaints.requested_resolution: Issue immediate credit note of PKR 240,000 and re-calculate invoices based on contractual index

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Systemic fuel surcharge applied at expired higher rate across multiple corporate invoices
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Billing representative refusal to adjust unlawful surcharges or issue credit note
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Systemic billing algorithm error applying outdated fuel surcharges compounded by frontline support inflexibility.

complaints.title: Approved insurance compensation of PKR 90,000 delayed for 50 days and surveyor report lost
complaints.description: Our transit loss claim CLM-88219 for PKR 90,000 was formally approved by your claims committee on August 5th, but payout has not reached our account after 50 days. When we escalated via phone today, your claims clerk shockingly stated that the department 'lost the original third-party surveyor inspection report' and demanded that we re-hire a surveyor at our own expense to re-inspect the lost cargo!
complaints.requested_resolution: Immediate disbursement of approved PKR 90,000 without requiring duplicate survey documentation

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Insured payout delayed past 30 days due to missing documentation or processing backlog
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Internal loss of certified surveyor assessment and improper demand for merchant re-filing
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: Severe insurance payout delay caused by internal record misplacement and bureaucratic friction.

complaints.title: Third consecutive fake missed delivery for bridal lehenga and status abruptly flipped to RTO
complaints.description: My custom bridal lehenga (CN-9910283741, value PKR 140,000) was scheduled for delivery for my wedding this Saturday. For three straight days, your courier marked 'Customer Not Available' without ever ringing our bell or calling our phones. Today, the tracking abruptly switched to 'Return to Origin - Customer Refused Delivery'. The package is being sent back to Karachi from Rawalpindi! Please stop this!
complaints.requested_resolution: Immediate intervention to halt RTO transit at Islamabad Hub and deliver to my address by 5 PM

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Third consecutive missed delivery attempt reaching threshold for return to origin
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Time-critical bridal event deadline threatened by fraudulent 'Customer Refused' status
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: High-emotion case where consecutive false delivery attempts triggered premature RTO on time-critical bridal attire.

complaints.title: Viral CCTV video of hub staff throwing packages over wall and 75-inch TV received shattered
complaints.description: We received our 75-inch Sony Bravia OLED TV (CN-995001992, declared value PKR 580,000) delivered to our house in Islamabad. The entire screen is cracked into a spiderweb pattern. Furthermore, a viral security camera video circulating on Twitter and TikTok shows RaftarXpress hub staff at Islamabad Hub literally throwing fragile packages 10 feet over a perimeter security wall into an open bed truck! This gross negligence is public knowledge!
complaints.requested_resolution: Immediate replacement TV / full refund of PKR 580,000 and executive apology for gross negligence

expected_ground_truth.primary_issue: Customer video of courier throwing fragile parcels goes viral on social media
expected_ground_truth.secondary_issue: Complete physical destruction of high-value OLED television shipment due to hub mishandling
expected_ground_truth.notes_for_reviewer: P0 brand reputation crisis and severe cargo damage triggered by viral social media video evidence.
